title: the contact force user function of ObjectContactSphereTriangle and ObjectContactSphereCylinder
author: Claude-JG
description: Further contact laws (and later bearing models) without a new item: a user function that replaces the built-in law. Decided (contactPrimitives.md section 8.5): contactForceUserFunction(mbs, t, itemNumber, gap, gap_t, normal, tangentialVelocity, impactVelocity) returning the global contact force on marker 0, the convention of the output Force; called while the data node says contact, the geometry and the active set stay in C++; also as a symbolic user function; for the primitive contacts on the shared law, the others as they come; revision2026c step RG9.12.14.
releaseNotes: ObjectContactSphereTriangle and ObjectContactSphereCylinder have a contactForceUserFunction, also symbolic, which replaces their contact law.
